violated_contract: Runtime Docker build contexts must exclude local validation environments and request-test scratch state; running local checks must not silently add those artifacts to the serving image.
canonical_prevention: Exercise every runtime context filter through the actual Docker builder with synthetic local-only files and real runtime source witnesses. On 2026-09-04 self-host builds copied a 581MB OpenAPI venv and a 110MB test scratch directory because the context filters excluded only .venv; repeated source and chown layers contributed to host disk exhaustion.
